Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.mediawriter

Class MediaWriterEngine

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.mediawriter.MediaWriterEngine
public final class MediaWriterEngine extends Object
Headless engine behind MediaWriterPanel: enumerates real block and optical devices and drives real burn / image / format operations by shelling out to the standard Linux media tools (dd, wodim/ cdrecord, growisofs, xorriso, mkfs.*, isohybrid, wipefs, parted).

This class performs destructive, irreversible writes to physical media. Every write path is guarded: internal fixed disks are never offered as a target, read-only devices are rejected, mounted filesystems are unmounted first, and the caller is expected to obtain an explicit confirmation before invoking a write method.

Deliberately free of Swing/AWT imports so it can be exercised headless. Long-running operations report through a MediaWriterEngine.ProgressHandler and honour cancel().

    • detectDevices

      public List<MediaWriterEngine.DeviceInfo> detectDevices()
      Enumerates block devices via lsblk plus optical drives, and returns them classified as OPTICAL / USB / DISK. Partition mount points are attached to their parent device so writes can unmount them first.

    • probeImage

      public MediaWriterEngine.ImageInfo probeImage(File f)
      Reads facts about an image file the user wants to write.

    • burnIsoToOptical

      public void burnIsoToOptical(MediaWriterEngine.DeviceInfo drive, File iso, Integer speed, boolean verify, MediaWriterEngine.ProgressHandler h)
      Burns an ISO to an optical drive. Chooses growisofs for DVD media, otherwise wodim/cdrecord (or xorriso -as cdrecord). Optionally verifies by reading the disc back.

    • writeImageToUsb

      public void writeImageToUsb(MediaWriterEngine.DeviceInfo usb, File image, boolean bootable, boolean verify, MediaWriterEngine.ProgressHandler h)
      Writes a raw image or ISO to a USB / removable device with dd. Unmounts first; optionally makes the image isohybrid-bootable (on a temporary copy) and verifies the write with a SHA-256 read-back.

    • formatUsb

      public void formatUsb(MediaWriterEngine.DeviceInfo usb, String fs, String label, boolean newPartitionTable, MediaWriterEngine.ProgressHandler h)
      Formats a USB / removable device. Optionally rebuilds a single-partition MBR table first, then creates the requested filesystem with a label.

    • cloneDisc

      public void cloneDisc(MediaWriterEngine.DeviceInfo src, MediaWriterEngine.DeviceInfo dst, boolean verify, MediaWriterEngine.ProgressHandler h)
      Clones one device to another by reading the source into a temporary image and writing it to the destination (optical burn or USB image write).

    • createDataDisc

      public void createDataDisc(File folder, File outIso, String volumeLabel, MediaWriterEngine.DeviceInfo drive, Integer speed, boolean verify, MediaWriterEngine.ProgressHandler h)
      Builds an ISO-9660 image from a folder (via xorriso or genisoimage) and, if a drive is given, burns it. The generated image is kept at outIso.
